textbookBox.concept: We can guess if it will rain by watching clues such as dark clouds, cool wind and the smell of wet earth. Elders know many clues. We can ask questions about the rain. Is it heavy or light?

beats.en: When it rains, water falls on different surfaces. On hard surfaces it flows away or dries up in the sun, and on soil much of it soaks in.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 3 evs · Water - A Precious Gift · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: Water is a gift of nature. It reaches our taps through pipes from a tank, and the tank is filled from a bigger source such as a river, lake or well.

beats.en: Water is a gift of nature. It reaches our taps through pipes from a tank, and the tank is filled from a bigger source such as a river, lake or well.
beats.speakEn: Water is a gift of nature. It reaches our taps through pipes from a tank, and the tank is filled from a bigger source such as a river, lake or well.

beats.en: Water is used for drinking, cooking, bathing, washing, cleaning and watering plants. When the supply stops, as it did for Surya and Barkha when the society pipeline burst, the water stored in buckets helps.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 3 evs · Water - A Precious Gift · Complete Summary
textbookBox.concept: Water is sacred because we cannot live without it. In some places it rains very little, and people walk long distances to get water. Everyone should get clean drinking water anywhere, anytime.
